column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3:
So this is Vale.
I see why you came back.
It feels almost safe.{page_break}I fought in another
world once. They had
places like this, too.{end_wait}
You're not welcome here.\nThese people haven't\ndone anything to you.{end_wait}

Does that matter?
I haven't hurt anyone
here. Not yet.{page_break}Go on, Isaac.
Check on your mother.
I'll wait.{end_wait}

All right. You won.
And Vale is still here.
Enjoy that feeling.{page_break}Go home, Isaac.
Your mother must be
worried about you.{end_wait}

Look at these soldiers.
All that courage,
and none of it mattered.{page_break}I could finish them.
But watching you choose
who to save is better.{end_wait}

Get away from them.
Your fight is with me.{page_break}You want me to choose
who gets left behind.
I know your game.{end_wait}

Oh, Isaac. You still
think you get to
make the rules?{page_break}Then come closer.
Let's see how many
more I can break.{end_wait}

You beat me, Isaac.
Does that make you
feel like a hero?{page_break}Those men are still
bleeding. Go on.
Save them.{page_break}I'll remember how
easy you are to hurt.{end_wait}
